description: Apply fixes to an existing data module. Each selection copies the location and ONE candidate of a fix that s1000d-verify-mcp suggest_fixes (or this server) returned: { location, action, target?, value? }. The server computes the fix candidates again and applies a selection only if it matches one of them; a value outside the candidates (or outside a range / pattern candidate) is not applied and comes back in rejected[] with the reason. "provide" candidates change the product, not the document: pass them as "product". The result is verified again. Returns xml, applied[], rejected[], verification, the fixes that remain. Writes only when write is true (a path is overwritten in place; xml is written under its own file name in the first CSDB folder).

allowInvalid.description: With write: true, write even when verification.schema.state is "invalid". Default false.

csdbDirs.description: CSDB folders used to resolve references, find BREX and number new objects (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file). The FIRST folder is also where write: true writes (it may not exist yet). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); other folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes.

maxFixes.description: Cap on the remaining fixes listed in the response (default 50).

overwrite.description: With write: true, replace a file of the same name. Default false: an existing file is left alone and reported as write-conflict.

product.description: The product to evaluate applicability for. attributes: ACT productAttribute id → value; conditions: CCT cond id → value. Omit to skip the applicability check.

location.description: Fix.location of the suggestion (omit when the fix has none, e.g. a missing element).

write.description: Write the result into the CSDB (the first folder of csdbDirs / S1000D_CSDB_DIR). Default false: the XML is only returned. Nothing is written when the XML is not valid against the XSD unless allowInvalid is true.

xml.description: An existing document as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB). Not for XML you wrote yourself: build new data modules with build_data_module.

name: apply_fixes
